projection.name: Moon2000 south polar stereographic
projection.formula: x = rho*sin(lon), y = rho*cos(lon), rho = 2R*tan(pi/4 + lat/2)

dem.citation: Smith, D.E., et al. (2010), LRO LOLA Gridded Data Records (LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0), NASA PDS
dem.method: 3x3 block mean of 40 m LDEM, rounded to 1 m

illumination.citation: Mazarico, E., et al. (2011), Illumination conditions of the lunar polar regions using LOLA topography, Icarus 211, 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030
illumination.method: 2x2 block mean of 60 m products; averages over 18.6-yr nutation cycle, hourly steps

terrain.citation: Barker, M.K., et al. (2021), Improved LOLA elevation maps for south pole landing sites: Error estimates and their impact on illumination conditions, Planet. Space Sci. 203, 105119, doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119
terrain.method: 4x4 block mean (elevation, mean slope) and block max (slope) of 5 m products

limitations: Longest continuous dark period is not a published LOLA raster product and is not included.
Boulder density is not included; the planner offers a DEM-derived roughness proxy only.
Illumination/Earth visibility are long-term averages at the surface (Mazarico et al. 2011), not at mast height.
